title: Opening the app starts about nine background jobs at the same moment as the first screen
what: The moment the app opens it redraws the widgets (working out today's what-to-beat lines from each lift's history when a Today widget is placed), resets reminders, re-sends owed Health Connect workouts, reads weigh-ins, and starts four gym syncs (leaderboard, gym mates, busy machines, trainers), all at once and with no wait. The same widget redraw with the what-to-beat work runs again every time the member leaves the app and comes back. On a cheap phone with a long history this can make the first seconds feel slow. Not measured on a phone.
expected: The first screen comes up first; the background jobs follow a moment later, one after another, and the widget redraw on leaving the app skips work whose answer has not changed.
fix_line: Start the background jobs a few seconds after the first screen shows, one at a time, and skip the widget's what-to-beat work when nothing changed

items.reason: this area is the phone app's Android code and phone helpers; no panel web pages here (pagespeed.json covers the panel)
no member lists here; the only lists are a member's own workouts, sent to Health Connect in parts of 500 and 200, and the owed list capped at 500
